title: bcc Fe: transferable Heisenberg exchange and its breakdown

decision_points.fork: Which spiral directions to buy and fit
decision_points.consequence: Shells alias (J1 = J2); J1 ~3 meV and [214] predictions off by ~24 meV/atom

decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit the 30-degree cone energies as flat spirals
decision_points.consequence: J1 and D low by sin^2(30 deg) = 1/4

decision_points.wrong_choice: Short-range model (4 shells) chosen by in-sample error
decision_points.consequence: Held-out [214] RMSE ~2.9 meV/atom, above the 2.5 tolerance

decision_points.fork: Whether the small-angle model describes large-angle disorder
decision_points.wrong_choice: Apply the spiral-fitted J to the random states

decision_points.fork: Which supercells to buy random states from
decision_points.wrong_choice: Small 3x4x1 or 2x2x1 cells whose images alias shells
decision_points.consequence: Random-state mean energy off by 20-25 meV/atom

decision_points.fork: Lattice constant of the random-state cells
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the spiral cell (2.87 A) shell radii for the 2.83 A supercells
decision_points.consequence: No neighbours found; model degenerates to a constant, mean energy off by ~23 meV/atom

decision_points.fork: Units of q for the stiffness
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reciprocal-lattice q without the 2 pi factor
Pair sum of a truncated exchange model
decision_points.consequence: D off by ~26% because long-range tails are unconstrained

decision_points.wrong_choice: Report J1 from the large-angle (random-state) model

graded_fields: spin_wave_stiffness_meV_A2 within 15% of the small-q reference

pilot.flag: dev-easy: both development models pass; conventions and fitting hygiene did not discriminate

notes: Curie temperature deliberately not graded: across equally valid fits the classical RPA Tc ranges 205-915 K (sometimes negative), so it is not uniquely recoverable; it is a rubric point instead.
